codeReview.summary: The fix commit resolves the three previously failed implementation areas (bundled hero asset, explicit activityId generic-title guard, and no-POI terminal marker) and updates key segmented controls to 44px, but one touch-target blocker remains and prior cross-area blocking gaps are still unresolved.

issues.description: Fullscreen overlay close button still uses `p-2` with a 24px icon (`w-6 h-6`), yielding an approximately 40px touch target, which is below the >=44px requirement at tablet width.
VAL-CROSS-004 remains unresolved (no marker-to-route distance proof within 500m). This fix commit does not add any cross-area evidence artifacts or code addressing that blocker.
VAL-CROSS-008 remains unresolved (missing end-to-end Add Photos -> Picker -> download -> markers/gallery evidence in one session). No new cross-area validation evidence was added by this fix.
VAL-CROSS-005 remains unresolved (missing hard-refresh network proof of Firebase-only reload with no Strava/Google Photos calls). No new evidence addresses this blocker.
